body:
If you’ve never listened to the podcast I cohost, I hope you’ll check out Learning How to See. We’re in Season 9 right now, which means you have 8 past seasons you can catch up on too. You’ll find links to your favorite platforms here:

 https://cac.org/podcast/learning-how-to-see/

  

 I’ve enjoyed being a guest on many other wonderful podcasts in 2025. Here are some recent ones.

 — I talked with Heather Bigley about a favorite move, The Color Purple, here.

 — I talked with Monica Ahlbin about my new novel, The Last Voyage , here.

 — I talked with friends from the Tadatmya Sangha about the soul and desire and so much more, here.

 — I talked with Andy Hale and the CBF community about my new novel, The Last Voyage , here.

 — I also talked about The Last Voyage with Kate Rademacher (two podcasts at once!), here.

  

 And if you want to read The Last Voyage , you’ll find ordering options here. A great Christmas gift … with volume 2 coming out fall 2026 and volume 3 in 2027.
